comment: This sample builds its content at RUN time rather than at build time: MainForm.LoadModel() calls ContentBuilder.Add(fileName, "Model", null, "ModelProcessor") for whichever file the Open dialog selected and then Load<Model>("Model"). evidence/build-results.txt records the run that produced the reference -- 'Selected source=Content/Cats.fbx' -- with the two digests the corpus froze, so the build unit is one item: Cats.fbx, named Model, no importer (the extension chooses it), ModelProcessor, Windows/Reach as the reference header says. Its nested texture cat_0.xnb is the ModelProcessor's own output beside it. Recorded 2026-09-10 (plans/plan_xna_sample_xnb_sweep.md XNASWEEP-163).
